description: Turn photo(s) into a short video. With `effect` (from list_effects) the effect decides the motion; without it the photo is animated following `prompt`. Costs credits. Returns a task_id; poll get_video for the result (usually 1–5 minutes).

effect.description: Effect id from list_effects. Omit for a free-form animation.

image_urls.description: Public https image URLs (or data:image/...;base64 URLs), in the order the effect asks for. Usually one photo.

prompt.description: Motion description for free-form animation, or extra instructions for an effect.

name: animate_photo
title: Animate a photo
